# Code of Conduct

## Our Commitment

We want PhosPy to be respectful, constructive, and welcoming to scientists,
developers, maintainers, and first-time contributors.

## Expected Behaviour

Please:

- be respectful in disagreement
- assume good faith where reasonable
- give specific, constructive feedback
- welcome newcomers and people still learning
- focus discussion on improving the project

## Unacceptable Behaviour

Unacceptable behaviour includes harassment, intimidation, personal attacks,
discriminatory comments, sexualised language or imagery, publishing private
information without permission, and repeated bad-faith disruption.

## Scope

This policy applies to GitHub issues, pull requests, discussions, reviews, and
other project spaces connected to PhosPy.

## Reporting

Report conduct concerns to the project maintainers. Include relevant links,
dates, screenshots, or context when you can do so safely.

## Enforcement

Maintainers may remove comments, close conversations, block participation, or
take other reasonable steps to protect the project community.

## Final Note

Direct technical feedback is welcome. Personal hostility is not.
